title: Agents and the change router name the Conduct for changes section, not all of maintaining.md
goal: AGENTS.md and .claude/hooks/kb_change_router.py send a change to python3 _tools/selfdoc.py section maintaining "Conduct for changes" instead of reading kb/_self/maintaining.md whole, the skill list is read only when picking a skill, and AGENTS.md stays under its 4 KB cap

gates.question: This story changes a rule in AGENTS.md (the read-before-change line). May it?
